plainTranslation: Venus square Mars: Venus square Mars, the sexual chemistry can be very high in a romantic relationship, and there’s a lot of energy involved no matter what type of relationship this is, but this can lead to some instability.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
note: Imported from The Dark Pixie Astrology composites material text.
